reports.title: MFL player ranks
reports.note: Report data unavailable; refresh from MFL to fill this report. Refresh failed. Try refreshing from MFL again.
reports.how: MFL's player rank, not the app's model. Up means last week's rank minus this week's rank is positive; down means negative. A last-week rank of zero means MFL supplied no previous rank. New this week is MFL's new-entry flag; no earlier rank is shown.

reports.title: Average draft position
reports.note: MFL reports no draft picks for all periods; average draft position is unavailable.
reports.source: Source: MFL-wide · many leagues, not this league
reports.how: MFL-wide across many leagues, not this league. All draft periods are requested, since the default period can have no picks in season. The bar runs from the lowest to highest pick reported, with the average marked; it is not a confidence interval or a grade. Every bar shares one scale, from zero to the latest pick any player went.

reports.title: Average auction value
reports.source: Source: MFL-wide · many leagues, not this league
reports.how: MFL-wide across many leagues, not this league's dollars. Every league's auction is scaled to a $1,000 pool across all its teams. No conversion to this league's money is made. The bar runs from the smallest to largest dollar value reported, with the average marked; it is not a confidence interval or a grade. Every bar shares one scale, from zero to the largest dollar value any player drew.
columns: AAV · min–max dollars on MFL’s $1,000 scale
